name: @geo-content-os/worker-outbox-relay
description: GEO Content OS — Outbox Relay：SKIP LOCKED 领取、BullMQ 投递、租约管理

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/observability build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --pretty false
